title: Specify declared artifact verdict when a task notification reports failed or error
outcome: The ordinary task-END route has an explicit tested contract for a failed/error provider task status with an otherwise valid passing artifact, consistent with the artifact-based declared-command rules.
acceptance: Record the source semantics of a provider task's failed/error status separately from a numeric command exit and from the declared artifact verdict; obtain coordinator concurrence before changing product verdict semantics.

A deterministic fixture supplies a failed/error task status with a valid PASS artifact and verifies the agreed observable verdict and diagnostic; native verification and declaration/source admission are not widened or newly restricted.
